text: Wheeze and cough for 3 weeks. Possible asthma vs post-viral cough. Referred to respirology. Advised to try salbutamol if wheeze persists.
Respirology consult. Spirometry normal; methacholine challenge booked. Asthma not yet confirmed.
CBC with differential. Collected 2026-04-30. Eosinophils: pending.
Patient asks about biologics such as Dupixent; discussed, not started.
Social: lives with a roommate who smokes. Patient's own smoking status not asked today.
Cough worse. Considered prednisone but held off; will reassess in one week.
